name: A tinker at work
about: A practitioner of a craft at their characteristic work, and an opportunity for the company to take part (Fun Fridays, 20 November; doc/design/fun-fridays-tinker-kit.md): here tinkering, written so that the same pattern serves a carpenter, a cook, a shepherd or a physician. The settlement and its square are bound to the region; who is at the work, and so what the work is, how they take a stranger's help and what comes of it, is Deem's to propose (a travelling tinker, generated, with a child's toy; an apprentice alone with an instrument they have made worse; a master of the craft short of a part). One occasion of the craft to a settlement; each passes: the tinker moves on, the master shuts the shop.
